title: Recover failed chase sends and hold uncertain outcomes
public_pr_body:
A failed Approve and send could leave the reviewed draft permanently claimed as sending. Definite failures now release the claim for a reviewed retry; uncertain outcomes and thrown sends become Needs checking and cannot send again automatically. Concurrent approvals still claim once, edits invalidate approval, and subjects the mailer would transform are refused.

Validation: 61 targeted approval/mailer tests passed. No database changes were applied. Targets `claude/chase-steps`, the same base as #191. Includes the existing #191 integration work plus the recovery fix.
